title: ClusterLM backend capability descriptor, contract v1 (ADR 0401; contract revision v1.1, ADR 0407)
description: Every capability is explicit: no optional capability fields (a missing capability is false/0/none, written out). Unknown fields are rejected.

id.description: Extended only by ADR together with factory_name.

factory_name.description: Name accepted by backends::make_backend (backend_factory.hpp). Pairing with id is fixed (allOf below).

role_in_product.description: development-only backends are never offered for product profiles, never listed in /v1/models, and their labels are never shown beside a real model.

tensor_formats.description: Canonical ggml type names (as in library TensorTypeStat.type, compared case-insensitively) the backend can execute. EVERY type in a model's tensor_types (not only its dominant quant) must be listed, else the model is Unsupported before provisioning. No wildcard or placeholder values.

family_match.description: Exact family or a '*'-glob over the library record's family label.

architecture.description: GGUF general.architecture the record must have (exact). Immutable, unlike the family label; F adds it to every entry whose status is above Experimental (ADR 0407).

evidence.description: CI job / test names / HQ ids that justify the label.

unlisted_family_status.description: Status for a model whose family is not listed. Never a Supported label. 'Experimental' means: a Host-only load is attempted only after an explicit per-model user opt-in; it is never distributable.

requires_runtime.description: e.g. 'cuda>=12.0'. Detected at runtime; absent => backend not offered (never advertised). Empty list = nothing beyond the binary.

validated_max_workers.description: Largest Worker count that has an automated test (real or fixture) behind it. 0 when cross_machine is false. Profile validation rejects max_workers above the CompatReport's max_workers (which is 0 for a non-distributable model). Raising it needs evidence recorded in `evidence`.

validated_topologies.description: Human-readable shapes covered by tests, e.g. 'host-prefix -> worker -> worker -> host-tail'.

cpu_gpu_hybrid.description: Weights/experts split across CPU RAM and GPU VRAM within one machine.

worker_roles.description: Stage roles a Worker may play. Prefix and tail are always Host (ExecutionDomain contract). Empty when cross_machine is false.

supports_rollback.description: How an aborted/partially accepted speculative window is undone (llama.cpp recurrent state without seq_rm falls back to recompute).

max_sessions_per_domain.description: Upper bound for DomainSpec.max_sessions and therefore for concurrent generations per prepared plan.

per_client_isolation.description: True when a session's state can be held and released independently of other sessions on the same domain. Required true for max_sessions_per_domain > 1 to be used by the scheduler.

serving.description: What the serving layer may rely on. Tool calling itself is a property of the model's chat template + parser, not of the backend; these are the backend-side prerequisites.

constrained_decoding.description: Grammar/JSON-schema constrained sampling available. If false, `response_format` json_schema requests are refused rather than emulated.

options_schema.description: Declares profile.backend.options. A restricted declarative subset (not general JSON Schema; the C++ side has no JSON Schema engine). Absent = no options accepted. Options never decide placement-owned quantities (layer split, GPU offload) and never bypass memory admission.

hardware_experiments.description: Ids in HARDWARE-QUALIFICATION.md that must pass to move the label to 'Supported and qualified'. Empty only for development-only backends.
